title: 第5344章 盾防服众第5343章 我要服众
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：九龙归一诀陆沉第5344章盾防服众（..la）百万骨族大军一到，一眼见到陆沉就站在人族大军前列，显然成为了人族大军的领头人。
领队的骨族高层原本还想劝退人族大军，但见如此状况，心知多说无益，干脆立即开战。
骨族大军仗着人多势众，兵力五路冲下来，直接将人族大军围了个水漏不通，从前后左右以及空中五个方向，对人族大军发起全面进攻。
唯一无法进攻的方向，就是地底！
这就是在敌众我寡之下，不要打天空战的主要原因，可减少一个被攻击的方向。
人族大军按照陆沉的安排，在地面上开辟战场，坚持以入口通道为中心，摆开防御阵型，死战不退！
人族大军对陆沉从不服到服从，从质疑到信任，只在一个盾防之间。
盾防一出，防御力飙升，给了所有人族战士实打实的自身安全，也有了对抗百万骨族大军的信心，不禁对陆沉心生感激。
而且，在敌人即将降临的时侯，陆沉不是让人族大军全力庇护，不是在人族大军里面躲着，然后什么都不干。
陆沉是顶到正面战场去，直接处于战斗的最前沿，率先承受骨族大军最猛烈的冲击，这份勇敢和担当就让人族大军佩服。
因此，所有人族战士形成了一个不反对的默契，也默认了陆沉的战斗指挥权。
有了盾防的加持，人族大军迎战骨族大军的时侯，轻松粉碎了骨族大军第一波最猛烈的冲击，防线坚如磐石、屹然不动。
防御力强大，让人族大军在作战的时侯特别勇猛，且所受到的伤害降到最低，伤亡率也降到最低。
可惜人族大军只有盾修支持，却没有神医支持，否则只有伤，没有亡。
尽管如此，伤亡的人族战士也不多，十多万人只死了几十人，受伤几百人而已。
对于人族大军来说，这点伤亡就不是什么事了，甚至可以忽略不计。
而骨族大军那边的伤亡率就有点大了，第一波冲击失败之后，竟然出现了上万人的伤亡，其中就有上千人战死。
两者比较下来，人族不伤皮毛，骨族损失惨重，人族算是赚翻了，骨族却输到姥姥家去了。
但战斗才开始，这只是骨族大军的第一波冲击而已，很快第二波冲击就来了，然后是第三波、第四波、第五波……
无论人族防线有多坚挺，骨族始终进攻不断，战斗逐渐打进了白炽化，双方的伤亡也越来越大了。

仅打了一个时辰的时间，人族已经阵亡了上千人，受伤不计其数，骨族更甚！
人族大军因为有盾防加持，在强大的防御力庇护下，勇猛作战、斩敌许多，倒是打得十分亮眼，
可全场打得最亮眼的个人，非陆沉莫属！
同阶无敌不是盖的，灭世拳无人可以抵挡，出拳又快，还一拳一个，打死的敌人碎骨残躯都快堆成了一座山。
上千个骨人倒在陆沉的拳下，全部被一拳打死，没有一个骨人的尸体是完整的。
而斩敌第二的那个人，就是韩兰。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Lu Chen, Chapter 5344 of Jiulong Guiyi Jue, Shield Defense Conquers the Crowd (..la) As soon as the millions of Bone Clan army arrived, Lu Chen was standing at the forefront of the human race army at the first sight, and he obviously became the leader of the human race army.
The senior Bone Race leader who led the team originally wanted to persuade the human race army to retreat, but seeing the situation, they knew that it would be useless to talk more, so they simply started a war immediately.
Relying on the strength of their numbers, the Bone Clan army rushed down in five directions and directly surrounded the human army. It launched an all-out attack on the human army from five directions, including front, rear, left, right and in the air.
The only direction that cannot be attacked is underground!
This is the main reason not to fight in the sky when the enemy is outnumbered. It can reduce one direction to be attacked.
According to Lu Chen's arrangement, the human army opened a battlefield on the ground, insisted on setting up a defensive formation with the entrance passage as the center, and fought to the death!
The human army went from obedience to obedience to Lu Chen, from doubt to trust, just between a shield and a shield.
As soon as the shield defense came out, the defense power soared, giving all the human warriors real safety and the confidence to fight against the millions of bone clan troops. They couldn't help but feel grateful to Lu Chen.
Moreover, when the enemy was about to come, Lu Chen didn't let the human army protect him with all his strength, or hide in the human army and then do nothing.
Lu Chen went to the frontal battlefield, directly at the forefront of the battle, and was the first to withstand the fiercest impact of the Bone Clan army. This bravery and responsibility made the human army admire him.
Therefore, all human warriors formed a tacit understanding of no objection and acquiesced in Lu Chen's battle command authority.
With the blessing of shield defense, when the human army faced the Bone Clan army, it easily crushed the first and most violent attack of the Bone Clan army. The defense line was as solid as a rock and remained motionless.
The strong defense makes the human army particularly brave when fighting, and the damage suffered is minimized, and the casualty rate is also minimized.
It's a pity that the human army only has the support of shield cultivators, but not the support of miracle doctors. Otherwise, there will only be injuries but no deaths.
Despite this, there were not many casualties among the human warriors. Only a few dozen were killed out of more than 100,000 people, and a few hundred were injured.
For the human army, this casualty is nothing, and can even be ignored.
The casualty rate of the Bone Clan army was a bit high. After the failure of the first wave of attacks, there were tens of thousands of casualties, including thousands of people killed in battle.
Comparing the two, the human race did not hurt their skin, while the bone race suffered heavy losses. The human race made a lot of money, but the bone race lost to grandma's house.
But the battle has just begun. This is just the first wave of impact from the Bone Clan army. Soon the second wave of impact came, and then the third wave, the fourth wave, the fifth wave...
No matter how strong the human race's defense line was, the Bone Race continued to attack, and the battle gradually became more intense, and the casualties on both sides were increasing.
After only fighting for an hour, the human race had already killed thousands of people and injured countless others, especially the bone race!
Because the human army was blessed with shields and under the protection of strong defense, they fought bravely and killed many enemies, and they fought very well.
But the person who played the most brilliantly in the whole game was none other than Lu Chen!
Being invincible at the same level is not a guarantee. No one can resist the World-Destroying Fist. The punches are so fast and one punch at a time. The broken bones and remains of the enemies they killed almost pile up into a mountain.
Thousands of skeleton men fell under Lu Chen's fist, and they were all killed with one punch. Not a single skeleton man's body was intact.
And the person who killed the second enemy was Han Lan.
